passive_monitoring.notes: Passive monitoring is OFF by default. Set enabled=true and consent_given=true to activate. Requires explicit user consent per privacy best practices.

mask_mode.notes: Mask Mode controls agent presentation style. true = JJK theme (default), false = professional mode. Toggle with 'Toggle mask mode' command.

user_technical_level.notes: User's declared technical expertise level. Affects all agent communication style, explanation depth, and autonomy. Options: beginner, intermediate, expert.

work_session_management.notes: Work session monitoring enforced by Gojo. Alerts at 4+ hours continuous work, late night (after 22:00), and extended sessions (6+ hours). User can configure thresholds in protocol.config.yaml.

session_tracking._comment: Domain Zero Protocol - Work Session State Tracking (v8.11.0)

agent_invocation_tracking._comment: Domain Zero Protocol - Agent Invocation Tracking (v8.12.0 PATCH-SESSION-004 Component 5)
agent_invocation_tracking._purpose: Track agent invocation patterns to detect session monitoring bypass (10-15% coverage gap)

bypass_alerts.message: Direct yuuji invocation during 265-minute session (bypasses Gojo monitoring)

bypass_detection._comment: Detects when agents are invoked directly without Gojo Mission Control (potential session monitoring bypass)

session_correlation._comment: Correlates agent invocations with session duration to detect patterns

script_orchestration._comment: Script orchestration run history — compact per-event records only. results{} stores the LATEST run per event (latest-wins). history[] is a chronological log capped at 50 entries (history_max).
